# RailsPilot

> AI-augmented Rails development. Staff Engineer reviewed.

RailsPilot delivers production-ready Ruby on Rails features weekly. An AI coding agent writes the code, and a Staff Engineer with 10+ years of Rails experience reviews every pull request. The service is designed for startups and teams that need to ship fast without the 3-4 month hiring cycle.

## What RailsPilot does

- Delivers 12 staff-level Rails features per month
- First feature ships within 24 hours of engagement
- Every PR is reviewed by a Staff Engineer (TDD enforced, ≥90% test coverage)
- Weekly planning calls to adjust priorities
- Month-to-month, cancel anytime

## Who it's for

- Teams with a Rails app and a clear backlog (15-50 issues)
- Technical founders or tech leads who can review PRs
- Companies that need to ship without hiring

## Pricing

- Monthly: $5,000/mo for 12 features ($500 per additional feature)
